cases.note: a registered component mounts with its resolved props
a custom element is mounted by its tag, its props set as properties
a native element from the allowlist mounts with its props as attributes
string children are text, kept in order around nodes
an expression in children renders as text; an absent value renders nothing
a node with no type renders its children with no element of its own
children nest to any depth
a named slot renders its node into the component, beside its children
`slot` puts a node into a web component's named slot
a prop bound to an expression follows the data it reads
a $ref renders the definition it names, as if written in place
a definition may use another definition
a $ref naming no definition renders the missing marker saying so, and its siblings render
a definition reaching itself is drawn once, with the missing marker where the cycle closes
a node held in an ordinary prop is handed to the component as data; only $if renders a prop
$each renders its children once per item, the item bound under `as`
without `as` the item is `item`
each row gets its position as `index` and the row before as `prev`, absent on the first
rows with no id of their own get `index` and `prev` the same way
an empty list renders nothing; a value that is not a list renders as an empty list
every child of $each is drawn for each item, in order
a nested $each shadows `item`, `index` and `prev`; the outer row stays reachable by its name
the rows follow the list: an added, removed or changed row is drawn as the list now is
items may be any expression producing a list
a truthy condition renders `then`
a falsy condition renders `else`
a falsy condition with no `else` renders nothing
the branch follows the condition
an absent value is falsy, as are 0, the empty string and the empty list is not
a literal condition is used as it is
a $if renders its branches only; children written on it are not rendered
$single renders nothing until its query has an answer — with no data source, nothing
the route matching the address renders at the $routes outlet, inside the root
the address a template opens on picks its route
a route's `:param` is read through navigation.params
a route with routes is a layout: its own $routes outlet holds the child route
an outlet behind a $if renders its route once the gate opens
an address matching no route renders nothing at the outlet
$invoke calls the store method with exactly its args, resolved when it fires
$invoke without args calls the method with none — the event is not passed on
an arg reading `event` is the value the handler received
onSuccess runs after the method's promise resolves, with `result` its value
onError runs after a rejection, with `result` the error; onFinally runs either way
a method that returns a plain value runs no lifecycle callback
a handler list runs each entry in order
$invoke naming a method the stores do not have does nothing, and nothing breaks
$setLocal writes a literal or what an expression computes when it fires
$setLocal reading `event` takes the value typed
$setLocal with `merge` shallow-merges into an object field
$toggleLocal flips a boolean field
$toggleLocalIn adds a value to a list field, or takes it out when it is there
per-row state: each row toggles its own id in one list and reads it back with `in`
$callLocal on a field holding no function does nothing; a store method read as a value is nothing, so it cannot arm one
$resetLocal on $scope puts every field of the scope back to its initial value
a handler-position $if runs `then` when its condition holds as the event fires
a handler-position $if's condition may read the event
each field starts at its declared initial value
an initial value may be an expression, resolved against the stores at mount
an inner scope sees the outer fields; a field of the same name shadows
a $localState inside a $each row is that row’s own
a syncParam field starts from the URL parameter when there is one
writing a syncParam field writes the parameter; back at the initial value it is removed
a persist field starts from device storage and writes back to it; $resetLocal clears it
URL parameter over stored value over initial
error() shows a rule’s message once the field is touched; formValid() is every rule passing
$animate keeps its one child mounted whatever its condition; only the transition follows it
$animate with no trigger renders its child
$surface binds the box it draws under `as` for its children to read
$agent binds the profile of the person `did` names, once it has arrived, under `as`
a $panels outlet is handed to the host as a lane, its props untouched
a $slot in a template (not module chrome) is not resolved and shows the marker
an unknown component renders the missing-component marker, and its siblings render
a we-* element nobody defined renders the missing marker, saying so, not an empty element
a part no module publishes resolves to a frame naming it, with nothing inside
a $part with no id resolves to nothing
an expression reading something absent gives nothing rather than an error
a javascript: URL is refused, literal or computed; an ordinary one stays
srcdoc is refused on any element
script, iframe and svg are refused as native tags: nothing is mounted
a write wired to an event nobody causes does not run; the same write on a press does
onSuccess counts as part of the press that started it, so a write there runs
an undefined we-* element in a row draws the marker in every row, and the rows around it render
a custom element outside the we- prefix is for the seed to name: mounted as written, no marker
a $ref in a template with no $defs at all renders the missing marker
a cycle through two definitions draws each once and the marker where it closes
a row of several children over records with ids: each drawn per item, and a change redraws them in place
a row of several children over plain values: each drawn per item
$animate with no transitions draws every child it holds
$animate with a condition and a reveal draws every child inside the one clip
$if draws then or else and never children, which the validator refuses
an initial string is text whatever it starts with, even where it names a bound value
$resetLocal naming anything but $scope resets nothing (and a validator refuses it)
a component's declared node props are drawn as nodes and handed over drawn; its other props stay data
a node in a declared node prop reads the scope of the node holding it, and follows it
a route body reads and writes the template root's $localState, and the root follows
a nested route sees the locals of the layout route that lists it, and of the root, the nearer shadowing
a route does not see locals declared between the root and its outlet: scope follows where a route is declared
a $ref in a route body draws the root's shape
a $ref in a route body naming no shape draws the missing marker there
a panel body, drawn apart from the root, reads the root's locals and shapes, and writes its locals
vbscript: and a data: URL that is not media are refused; a data: image stays
an on… prop holding text on a native element is refused: it would be a script
style, link, object and embed mount nothing either
